sql: SELECT md5(l.id::text) AS id,l.connection_id::text,l.source::text,md5(l.sync_run_id::text) AS sync_run_id,md5(l.upload_batch_id::text) AS upload_batch_id,md5(l.order_line_key) AS order_line_key,md5(l.order_no) AS order_no,md5(l.product_no) AS product_no,CASE WHEN coalesce(l.product_name,'') ~* '(@|[0-9]{2,3}[- ][0-9]{3,4}[- ][0-9]{4}|각인|성함|전화|연락처|주소|배송메모|주문자|수령인)' THEN NULL ELSE l.product_name END AS product_name,CASE WHEN coalesce(l.option_name,'') ~* '(@|[0-9]{2,3}[- ][0-9]{3,4}[- ][0-9]{4}|각인|성함|전화|연락처|주소|배송메모|주문자|수령인)' THEN NULL ELSE l.option_name END AS option_name,CASE WHEN coalesce(to_jsonb(l)->>'option_value','') ~* '(@|[0-9]{2,3}[- ][0-9]{3,4}[- ][0-9]{4}|각인|성함|전화|연락처|주소|배송메모|주문자|수령인)' THEN NULL ELSE to_jsonb(l)->>'option_value' END AS option_value,l.quantity::text,l.sale_price_krw::text,l.total_order_krw::text,l.total_paid_krw::text,CASE WHEN l.payment_method ~ '(^|,)[[:space:]]*쿠폰[[:space:]]*(,|$)' THEN '쿠폰' ELSE '' END AS payment_method,l.provider_coupon_signal,l.actual_order_price_krw::text,l.actual_shipping_fee_krw::text,l.order_date::text,l.import_version,l.validation_status::text,l.created_at::text,l.provider_updated_at::text,md5(l.source_row_hash) AS source_row_hash,md5(l.product_id::text) AS legacy_product_id,md5(l.cafe24_product_rule_id::text) AS legacy_match_rule_id,count(*) OVER()::int AS query_row_count FROM meta_ads.cafe24_order_lines l WHERE l.is_current AND l.order_date='2026-10-26'::date ORDER BY l.id LIMIT 10001
